views.name: player_heights
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    p.player_api_id,
    p.player_name,
    p.height
FROM
    Player AS p
views.description: Selects player height and player name.

views.name: league_goals_2015_2016
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(m.goal) AS total_goals
FROM
    Match m
JOIN
    League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE
    STRFTIME('%Y', m.date) = '2015' AND STRFTIME('%Y', m.date) = '2016'
GROUP BY
    l.name
views.description: Calculate total goals scored by each league in the 2015/2016 season.

views.name: match_league_goals
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS home_team_goals,
    SUM(m.away_team_goal) AS away_team_goals
FROM Match AS m
JOIN League AS l
    ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
views.description: Aggregate goals scored by each league in each match.

views.name: away_wins
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  T2.team_api_id AS `away_team`,
  COUNT(T1.id) AS `win_count`
FROM "Match" AS T1
JOIN "Team" AS T2
  ON T1.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE
  T1.home_team_goal < T1.away_team_goal
GROUP BY
  T2.team_api_id
views.description: Aggregates wins for away teams based on the match data.

views.name: team_buildUpPlaySpeed
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes AS t
views.description: Selects the buildUpPlaySpeed for each team.

views.name: top_4_teams_buildUpPlaySpeed
views.body_sql:
SELECT T2.buildUpPlaySpeed AS buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes AS T2
INNER JOIN Team AS T1 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
ORDER BY T2.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4
views.description: Selects the buildUpPlaySpeed of the top 4 teams based on their ranked buildUpPlaySpeed.

views.name: player_age
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id AS player_id,
  STRFTIME('%Y', '2024-05-03') - STRFTIME('%Y', p.birthday) AS current_age
FROM "Player" AS p
views.description: Calculate the current age of each player.

views.name: player_heights_7
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.id AS player_id,
  p.height AS height
FROM Player AS p

views.name: filter_buildUpPlaySpeed
views.body_sql:
SELECT T1.team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes AS T1
WHERE T1.buildUpPlaySpeed BETWEEN 51 AND 59
views.description: Select teams where buildUpPlaySpeed falls between 51 and 59 inclusive.

views.name: league_goals_per_season
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.name
views.description: Calculate the total goals scored by each league across all seasons.

views.name: player_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    m.id AS event_id,
    'event' AS event_type,
    1 AS event_value,
    p.player_name AS player_name
FROM
    Match AS m
JOIN
    Player AS p ON m.away_player_11 = p.player_api_id
WHERE
    p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'
views.description: Select events for a specific player.

views.name: average_long_shot
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  AVG(
    Match."B365H"
  ) AS "average_event_value"
FROM Match
WHERE
  Match."goal" = '1'
  AND Match."shoton" != '0'
LIMIT 1000
views.description: Calculate the average value of long-shot events.
